about: The one style every Clockwork Spire painting is generated with (docs/art-direction.md). core goes on every prompt; each kind adds its framing. Never edit for one asset: change it here, for all, with a decision.
core: storybook steampunk illustration, painterly digital art, clean confident black linework, rich brass and copper, teal accents, warm amber lamplight glow, soft painterly shading, light from the upper left, high quality
negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, extra limbs, deformed, bad anatomy, text, watermark, signature, logo, cropped, multiple characters

character.framing: full body, whole figure visible, limbs held clearly apart from the body, isolated on a plain flat light gray background, no scenery, game character sprite reference
character.negative: background scenery, frame, border, circle, vignette, cropped feet, floor shadow pool

part.framing: a single clockwork machine part seen straight on, centered, isolated on a plain flat light gray background, game item icon, crisp edges
part.negative: background scenery, frame, border, hands, person, multiple objects

scene.framing: wide establishing shot, atmospheric depth, layered silhouettes, game background art, open calm area for interface
scene.negative: characters in the foreground, frame, border
